create_pocketdynamo.ponder.portable_moto: Portable Motors turn Forge Energy stored in their battery into Rotational Force
While charged, they work as a source of Rotational Force anywhere
The speed and its direction are selected on the value panel. Better motors allow higher speeds
Spinning faster costs more energy, even with nothing connected. Goggles show the battery and the drain
Sneak and use a Wrench to pick it up. Its charge and selected speed are kept in the item
Place it somewhere else and it carries on with the same charge
The battery is filled with Forge Energy from any block placed next to the motor
A Solar Panel pushes the energy it generates straight into an adjacent battery
When the battery runs out the motor stops. It starts again by itself as soon as it has charge
Energy Cables can bring power from panels that are further away
create_pocketdynamo.ponder.solar_panel_s: Solar Panels generate Forge Energy from sunlight
They need an open sky above them. Night and rain greatly reduce their output
Copper, Brass and Diamond panels generate progressively more energy
Panels push their energy into adjacent Energy Cables. Cables connect to each other and to anything that stores energy
This way a motor can be charged from a field of panels placed away from it
create_pocketdynamo.ponder.tag.pocket_po: Portable, battery-powered motors, solar panels and cables
create_pocketdynamo.recipe_info.energy_c: Carries Forge Energy. It connects on its own to other cables and to any block that accepts energy.
Moves up to %1$s FE per tick through each segment.
create_pocketdynamo.recipe_info.motor.de: Turns Forge Energy from its internal battery into Rotational Force, anywhere. Speed and direction are selected on its value panel.
create_pocketdynamo.recipe_info.motor.dr: Drains %1$s FE per tick for each RPM it spins at, plus the energy needed by the load it carries. Faster costs more.
create_pocketdynamo.recipe_info.motor.st: Max speed: %1$s RPM. Stress capacity at max speed: %2$s SU. Battery: %3$s FE.
create_pocketdynamo.recipe_info.solar_pa: Generates Forge Energy from sunlight and pushes it into adjacent cables, motors and batteries. Needs open sky; night and rain reduce its output.
Output: up to %1$s FE per tick in full sunlight. Internal buffer: %2$s FE.
